theorem le_rAlpha_of_not_mem {α y δ δ₀ r Q : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hy : 0 < y) (hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀)
    (h : Approx2 α y δ a q Q) (hα : α ∉ majorArcs δ₀ r y) :
    r ≤ max 1 (|δ| / δ₀) * q := by
  by_contra hlt
  push Not at hlt
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q := Nat.cast_nonneg q
  have h1 : (q : ℝ) < r := lt_of_le_of_lt (by nlinarith [le_max_left 1 (|δ| / δ₀)]) hlt
  have h2 : |δ| / δ₀ * q < r := lt_of_le_of_lt
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_right _ _) hq0) hlt
  refine hα (mem_majorArcs_of_approx hy h h1.le ?_)
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hδ₀] at h2
  linarith

proof_context.conclusion: If α ∉ 𝔐_{δ₀,r}(y) and 2α = a/q + δ/y (mod 1) then r ≤ max(1,|δ|/δ₀)·q (contrapositive of `mem_majorArcs_of_approx`).

have hrw : min 1 w * n ≤ max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q := by
    have e : w * (|δ| / w) / 8 = |δ| / 8 := by field_simp
    rw [e] at hmm
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hw0] at hr
    calc min 1 w * n ≤ min 1 w * (max 1 (|δ| / w / 8) * q) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (le_min zero_le_one hw0.le)
      _ = min 1 w * max 1 (|δ| / w / 8) * q := by ring
      _ ≤ max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmm hq0
  rcases le_or_gt (q : ℝ) (z ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6) with hq | hq
  · have key := norm_S_eta2_le_gx hz h hq (by linarith)
    have hup := r_le_cube_root hz h hq
    have hmono := gx_antitoneOn hz ⟨hlow, hrw.trans hup⟩ ⟨hlow.trans hrw, hup⟩ hrw
    calc ‖S eta2 z α‖ ≤ gx z (max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q) * z := key
      _ ≤ G * z := by
          gcongr
          exact hmono.trans (hG1 (hrw.trans hup))

proof_context.conclusion: With r_w = max(1,|δ|/8)q ≥ min(1,w)n (from `le_rAlpha_of_not_mem` and `min_mul_max_le`) and q ≤ z^{1/3}/6, `gx_antitoneOn` gives g_z(r_w) ≤ g_z(min(1,w)n), so |S_{η₂}(α,z)| ≤ g_z(min(1,w)n)·z.
